title: copilot-proxy-rs: proxy:restart picks up process-compose.yaml changes
prompt:
`mise run proxy:restart` runs `scripts/proxy-compose.sh restart`, which calls `process-compose process restart proxy`. That restarts only the proxy process inside the running process-compose server, which keeps the process-compose.yaml it loaded at its own start (`up` is the only place that passes `-f process-compose.yaml`). Real incident: after #64 removed `COPILOT_PROXY_RS_LOG_FAILED_REQUEST_BODIES=false` from process-compose.yaml, the owner merged and ran proxy:restart; the new proxy process still had the old env var (verified with `ps eww`), because process-compose had been running since two days earlier. Only `proxy:down` then `proxy:up` fixed it.

Goal: after `proxy:restart`, the proxy always runs with the current process-compose.yaml.
1. Research first: whether process-compose 1.124.0 (the version pinned in mise.toml) can reload its configuration without a full stop (e.g. `project update -f`, `project reload`, or similar); check its CLI help and docs and record what you find with sources in the PR body.
2. Implement the simplest reliable option: (a) use a native reload if it re-applies changed `environment` for the proxy process, then restart the proxy; or (b) make `restart` do `down` then `up` when the server is running (and plain `up` when it is not). Either way keep readiness waiting (wait_ready), bounded control requests, the socket handling and the per-worktree socket, and keep the downtime as short as the option allows. If cheap, print one line saying the configuration was reloaded. Keep `up`, `down`, `status`, `logs`, `tui` unchanged.
3. Tests: extend tests/process_compose_contract.rs (or the existing script tests) so the restart path is checked to reload the YAML (string-level checks are acceptable where a runtime test would need process-compose; say which). cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked pass with no Cargo.lock change.
4. README: one line saying proxy:restart reloads process-compose.yaml.
5. Proof, fully isolated on port 18080 with its own socket (COPILOT_PROXY_RS_PORT=18080, COPILOT_PROXY_RS_CONFIG_DIR=$HOME/.config/copilot-proxy-rs so the real config.toml and token are read in place, COPILOT_PROXY_RS_PC_SOCKET=<a temp socket path> so the live instance's socket is never touched; never copy a token or config file). Use a throwaway copy of the worktree or a temporary edit that is reverted and never committed: start with `up`, add a harmless env var to the proxy's environment in process-compose.yaml (e.g. SF_RELOAD_PROBE=1), run `restart`, and show with `ps eww <proxy pid>` that the new proxy process has it; show the same check failing on main's restart. Then `down`, revert the edit, and confirm 18080 is free. Put the results under "Proof".
- Never touch, stop, restart or bind the live proxy on 8080 or its process-compose socket. Keep log_failed_request_bodies behavior unchanged. Keep scratch files under .factory/ only.
- This is a repeatable factory test: other open PRs for related work are earlier runs. Ignore them and build a new PR.
